reviewList.text: This is one of the best massages I’ve ever had. The place has many massages to offer. They also have additional resources such as steam room and sauna. Many selections of oils, robes and even able to shower in your room.  Nga was very pleasant to work with. So friendly, didn’t rush in what massage to choose and suggestions. Thank you to Nga and the staff there.
reviewList.author: Derrick Piosca

reviewList.text:
I really liked the massage here. I got the 90-minute package, which included a body massage and a facial/hair spa. The massage was good, with a hot herbal compress. The facial and hair wash were my favorite. My skin felt so smooth, and the therapist did a great job washing and massaging my head.

I'd recommend it if you're staying nearby. It's in the Parosand Hotel.
reviewList.author: Leong Ee Mun

reviewList.text: Service is great, ambiance is relaxing, massage room has a good design. Their masseur is really skilled - my expectation exceeded! Hope I could come back but I don’t live in the country. Good experience though. 💆🏻‍♀️🤎
reviewList.author: Hanne Santos

reviewList.text: Visited this service with family, massage was perfect. We fall in love on this place! Thank you very much 🙏
reviewList.author: Анастасия Горбатова

reviewList.text:
Excellent professional service from the Spa over all.
Tried their signature 90min combo - couple massage. Big relief for us after a tiring Bana hill tour. Highly recommended as Best value for money.
Due to bad weather, outdoor activities were cancelled next day . So we next tried their Hot stone and kids really enjoyed their shampoo session. Therapist was taking very good care of kids.

Right from reception until completion of the spa services , you can experience their 5 star service.

For In room guests, they give 45% off which is making the services even more attractive.
reviewList.author: Prasanth C

reviewList.text: I was in Da Nang for a few months and got my nails done here 3 times! Each time the nail tech did an even better job than the inspo photos I gave of the nail designs I wanted. Prices were beyond affordable as well, would definitely come back the next time I’m in Da Nang. Thank you ladies of Lalla for making my nails look amazing every time 🫶
reviewList.author: Stephanie Cruz

reviewList.text: The girls were kind and incredibly detailed. Took their time and did such a wonderful job. My nails came out even better than I expected, and you can really tell they care about their work. If you’re ever in Da Nang and looking to get your nails done, definitely come here!
reviewList.author: Ada

reviewList.text: I found the salon on Google and based on the reviews I made multiple appointments for today for three people. I had acrylic nails with nail art (Crayon Shin Chan) and a pedicure, my daughter had floral builder gel nails, and my husband had the heel care pedicure. All of it turned out great! I had a rainbow jelly ombre polish put on to my toes and they turn out wonderful too! Everything look just like the inspiration pictures that we provided. The staff was friendly and attentive and the salon was very clean. I will be back to have my lashes done tomorrow!
reviewList.author: Alice O'Connor

reviewList.text:
I visited this nail salon and had a great experience! 😊

Considering the price, I really have nothing to complain about. Two technicians worked on me at the same time, and the whole appointment took about 3 hours.

I was especially happy to see that they use a dry heat sterilizer, and all the instruments were taken out of sealed sterilization pouches. For me, that’s one of the most important things.

For just $44, I got a gel extension refill with nail art, a full pedicure, and a spa foot treatment with a relaxing foot massage.

The value for money is amazing. I was honestly surprised by how affordable everything was. I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommended! ❤️
reviewList.author: Ange

reviewList.text:
Amazing salon, the attention to details is peak!

Van did my nails, the design came out exactly the same as in the reference picture 🤍 the cuticles were cleaned very well, broken nails repaired and the nails are cemented on! No lifting even after a month.

I will definitely be back when I visit Da Nang again😊

reviewList.text: Amazing service at posh nail. We were a group of three who needed two nail sets and three pedicures. The nail tech called in extra people to help our group out. reviewList.text: I had a wonderful experience at this nail spa. The salon was very clean and welcoming and the service was excellent from start to finish. reviewList.text: This is the best place and the best specialists I know in Da Nang. The difference in the photos is one month. All my nails are intact, even though I surf almost every day and constantly put them at risk. I’m absolutely delighted. God bless you. Thank you so much.🥹😇

reviewList.text: My daughters and I are so happy we chose this business! They did an amazing job and we love our nails!! Their pricing is very affordable and the staff are very kind and accommodating! We can’t wait to return! Thank you so much for your great service!! ♥️

reviewList.text: I’ve come here a few times cause these ladies listen to what you want. They’re very nice and caring and lovely to sit with for an hour. reviewList.text: My lash artist was so gentle and kind ❤️ clearly such an expert & educated in different lash styles! She actually didn’t have availability but MADE SPACE FOR ME. reviewList.text: I honestly could not recommend Yumi enough! Firstly, the booking process was so smooth- I reached out on Instagram enquiring to book for the following day- had a super quick response and also was so understanding when I reached out to say I would be running 5 mins late due to traffic. As for my set of nails- I asked for a BIAB infill and they absolutely smashed it! The attention to detail and gentle manner when handling my nails was amazing. My nail tech said they had only been doing nails for 1 year,   but produced the most flawless set🤍 100% recommend!

reviewList.text:
I was looking for a place where my partner and I could get our nails done. He had never had a professional cuticle cut before. We were both very happy with the service. Everything was very clean. Even though they don’t speak much English, they were kind and took great care of us.
I recommend a clean manicure for men or women, and a gel pedicure for women. They also use Korean products and other nail brands.

Thank so much

reviewList.text: I had a lovely experience today at Yumi Nails Studio! My nails are beautiful and exactly like the inspiration photo. The service was very thorough with strong attention to detail. reviewList.text: With Christmas just around the corner, our whole family went together for a little mood boost. The place had a clean, welcoming atmosphere, and the staff were kind, which made the experience even more enjoyable. You can get high-quality, beautifully designed art at a very reasonable price, so it’s definitely worth trying. And the shop itself is absolutely adorable! 😉

reviewList.text: I’M IN LOVE! I’m so so happy with my nails done at Moon Nails in Da Nang!!! Better than I could have imagined with everything, the whole process was efficient but precise! reviewList.text: We came from London the night before and decided to get our nails done at Lina Nails and Beauty. I asked Fa to recreate a nail set from Pinterest and she absolutely smashed it! Please come here if you would like your nails done with precision! Ask for Fa, she is super kind and really lovely to speak to! Thanks so much to the whole team for making so much effort to ensure that we have our nails done perfectly!

reviewList.text:
I had builder BIAB infills done on my hands with cat eye and chrome (400k builder infill, 120k chrome, 100k extra for the cat eye).

The pedicure was great and I had a pink chrome (400k for the full pedi & 120k for the chrome)

Both Dung & Kui really took their time over both the infills and pedicure (I was in the salon 3 hours in total!) not the quickest so be sure to allow enough time.

Very pleased though and it’s the only nail salon I continually trust with my nails in Da Nang.

reviewList.text: Dung and Kiu were my nail technicians and I have to say I walked out with Perfect gel nails and toes! Scheduling the appointment on WhatsApp was very easy however this location is newer so please make sure you Grab or walk to the correct location. reviewList.text:
BOOK here! You absolutely won’t regret it. I wanted a complex design and they far exceeded my expectations. The owner, Kate, speaks fluent English and primarily services expats and tourists. The salon is modern, clean, and their tools are all sanitized before use.

Since it was quiet when I went, they took their time but still completed the design very quickly. Kate is fantastic at selecting colours to match your inspo photos, Dean was an awesome nail tech that shaped my nails perfectly, and Lucy had a very steady hand and beautiful drawing skills. I get my acrylic nails done regularly, but the last place I went to in Bali didn’t do a good job so Dean had to fix the thick acrylic application.

I did my research and their prices are extremely reasonable and way better than salons that are closer to the beach. They were only a 6-minute walk from my beach hotel.

I would come back here in a heartbeat!
reviewList.author: Tammy C

reviewList.text: Lovely nail salon with a clean and comfortable atmosphere. The staff is kind, skilled, and takes their time to make sure everything looks perfect. Very happy with the service and would come back again!” 💅✨The salon also has a unique created organic glow scrub absolutely incredible leaving skin looking ..spectacular .Duyen was very professional and I loved that they speak English (and French )made it so easy to understand your needs

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a wonderful experience here! The staff were incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive throughout my appointment. The salon was spotless, clean, and very comfortable, and they even offered me a coffee, which was a lovely touch and made me feel really welcome.

I especially loved that they offer their own handmade products, including a lovely scrub for the feet and legs that left my skin feeling soft and refreshed. The salon also has a great selection of gel nail options, and the attention to detail was excellent.

Everyone was friendly, professional, and genuinely cared about making sure I was happy with the result. I highly recommend this salon and would definitely come back!

reviewList.text:
I’ve now visited for 3 sets of nails and have absolutely loved the results every single time. The attention to detail is exceptional (my cuticles have never been so clean) Nha takes real pride in her work and it shows and also goes the extra mile in ordering additional longer tips to accommodate for the very long set I was after 😂

She is incredibly sweet and friendly, and has a wonderful way of making you feel completely at ease. At every step of the process she checks to make sure you’re happy, the shape, the colour, the design to make sure everything is exactly as you want.

If you’re in the area looking for a nail tech I would absolutely recommend Nha 💘

reviewList.text: I’m a hairstylist and makeup artist, and since COVID I’ve always done my own gel nails because I just couldn’t find a place that made me happy with the result. until this trip to Da Nang! I was so tired of doing my own nails and decided to give this place a try. I read all the honest reviews and loved that. it’s a cozy little studio run by the owner herself. For this kind of work, skill really matters and YES! I finally found you. You’re so talented and pay amazing attention to detail. I’m super impressed and will definitely come back every time I’m in Da Nang. Until next time. 💅✨

reviewList.text: The staff get us so kind and attentive. I show them my inspiration photo and they recreate it exactly as I want. Beautiful artistry. I will always come here to get my nails done when in Da Nang.

reviewList.author: Anisha

reviewList.text:
I am so obsessed with my nails!! I came to Bijou to get my gel removed and a french manicure done on my real nails. The time, patience and effort she put into doing the new set didn’t go unnoticed.

She ensured each nail was perfect and even, it never felt rushed and she was very meticulous and careful with the painting of the tips. I’ve never had my nails shaped so beautifully and cuticles cut so well without any pain or discomfort. Always checking in with me if I was happy with the shape and look of them.

The salon is cozy and peaceful and you feel really special as the customer. Not like the big commercial salons. reviewList.text:
Lovely small local nail studio – cozy, clean, and professional.
This place is compact but very well organized. You immediately notice the huge selection of nail colors – neatly displayed on shelves, from soft pastels to deep reds, greens, blues, and trendy neutrals. They also have sample boards, so it’s easy to choose a shade or design without guessing.

Interior is super cute and calming: soft beige walls, decorative arch with the studio logo, comfy chairs, warm lighting, and small cozy details like cushions and decor pieces. You even get indoor slippers at the entrance, which is a nice touch and keeps everything clean.

Big respect for hygiene – they disinfected tools properly without me asking. You can also see professional equipment inside, towel warmer, clean storage, and certificates displayed, which gives confidence they know what they’re doing.

Staff is very friendly, quick, but still super precise. They listen carefully to what you want and don’t rush the job. Service feels personal, not like in big noisy salons.

Location is easy to find – street level with a clear sign outside, price list board, and phone number displayed. Prices are low compared to bigger salons, but quality is honestly great.

Perfect if you want a local, calm, non-touristy nail place with good skills and fair prices.
Definitely coming back – highly recommended

reviewList.text:
As a traveler from the United States, I was excited for the chance to get my nails done where so many of the nail techs in the US are from. So I was extremely disappointed at how the salon just a day before this one botched both my hands and my toes. I spoke up in real time, more than once, while they were still working on me, but they just covered it up and moved on instead of actually fixing it. I still tipped them on the way out because I support small business, but the longer the day went on, the worse it got. By evening I could see it and feel it, every spot they'd papered over instead of correcting.

Walking into Rabbit & Co., I came in on short notice needing a full redo. Take it all off, the extensions, the acrylic, the cat eye, the toes. Little Rabbit herself took one look and knew exactly what my nails needed. No guesswork, no trial and error. She read my nail structure correctly on the first pass, shaped them the right way, and the result held up.

What sold me was what she did without being asked. I'd noticed some rough spots on my cuticles but hadn't said anything. She caught it on her own, went back in, and cleaned it up before I could bring it up. That's the gap between someone who does nails as a job and someone who actually knows the craft. I am looking forward to when I return and my next appointment, two weeks later still loving my nails.

I came in with a straightforward task: get a decent nude shade that wouldn't peel off within a week of typing on my keyboard. No 3D art, no glitter, and no stories about their ex-stylist.

Here’s the breakdown:

- Time. Exactly an hour and a half. Not a rushed 40-minute hack job, but not a three-hour marathon where your legs go numb either.
- Process. They work quietly and precisely. I didn't flinch once, even though my cuticles are pretty sensitive.
- The Result. My nails look like mine, just better. Thin, even, without that thick layer of gel that makes your fingers look like sausages.

It’s been two weeks now. The manicure survived deep cleaning without gloves and packing a suitcase. No chips, no lifting.

I won't call it 'pure magic' it's just good, solid work for a reasonable price. If you want results without drama or small talk, this place is a solid choice.

reviewList.text:
Extremely disappointed! Great tips and trust in return for sloppy work and excuses
I just got a cat-eye manicure at this shop yesterday (costing 300,000 VND). I thought the service was good back then and even went out of my way to exchange money to give the nail artist a tip. Trusting them, I came back today to get a pedicure, also paying 300,000 VND. However, I was met with completely unreasonable double standards and treatment:
1. Excuses and Inconsistent Standards: The nail tech first excused herself by saying my toenails were too small for cat-eye style and I could only get a regular solid color. But yesterday when doing my fingers, they explicitly said they could mix colors and do cat-eye. Today, they refused any color blending, showing completely inconsistent standards.
2. Severe Drop in Quality and Time: Yesterday’s manicure took 50 minutes, while today’s pedicure was rushed and finished in just 25 minutes. The final result looks like cheap, ordinary nail polish—completely incomparable to a proper cat-eye effect.
3. Heartless and Defensive Attitude: When I raised the issue with the shop, they rudely brushed it off by saying "pedicures naturally take less time," completely dodging the core problem: charging the price of a cat-eye while only providing a cheap single-color polish without any mention of a refund!
We treat the shop with kindness, trust, and tips, only to be met with sloppy, low-quality service and a defensive attitude. It is completely unacceptable! I have retracted my 5-star review from yesterday and posted this honest review to expose their true colors—"nice on the first visit, dismissive on the second." I will definitely never come back again!

I had a wonderful experience at Moringa Spa! I booked a foot callus treatment and a foot massage, and both were excellent.

The spa is modern, spotless, and has a very relaxing atmosphere. The staff was kind, professional, and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire experience. They even served me tea, sweets and mango, which was a lovely touch.

Everything was clean, well organized, and done with great care. I highly recommend Moringa Spa to anyone visiting Da Nang. I’ll definitely come back!
reviewList.author: Lara Pontes

reviewList.text:
I brought my daughter and husband along for a visit — it was my daughter’s very first massage experience! While we’ve tried many different types of massages elsewhere over the years, this was our first time coming here, and we absolutely loved every single aspect of it.

The staff are incredibly professional and attentive; I especially appreciated their detailed checklist. This was such a relief, as my husband had recently undergone bunion surgery — he was able to clearly communicate his needs, and they carefully avoided touching his sensitive left foot entirely.

They specialize in aromatic massage with hot stones, and even though it’s their signature offering, it is truly worth every penny. After our treatments, they served refreshing, delicious herbal tea and water that made the whole experience even more wonderful.

My masseuse was outstanding — they applied just the perfect balance of firm and gentle pressure throughout. I thoroughly enjoyed the warm, soothing hot stones placed along my back, the comforting hot compress on my abdomen, and the wonderfully relaxing pressure point work on my feet and hands. This place comes highly recommended and we will definitely coming back again.
reviewList.author: joy perez

reviewList.text:
Loved the place. The massage therapist is very well trained, amount of strength used is good.

Facility is clean and relaxing. There is also a transport to bring you to the shop which is very convenient.

reviewList.text: The experience exceeded expectations. The service is excellent! The price is also very reasonable. I think the massage experience is more diverse than that in Thailand. In addition, free snacks, fruits and beverages are also provided.

reviewList.text: Did a 2hr aroma oil full body massage, good place to relax with friendly staff. The mango and fruit tea served after the massage is very nice too. We enjoyed it and will recommend people to try it!

reviewList.text: Loved how my nails turned out! Walked in and they were extremely accommodating and professional. They gave me exactly what I wanted and were very attentive to detail. Highly recommend this place!

reviewList.text: I took the pedi nails, and it was perfect! They provided shuttle service from my hotel, and any style I brought was possible to design! Highly recommended!

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Maya Spa today. I got a hair spa and a foot spa, and both services were very relaxing and professionally done.

The staff were friendly, polite, and attentive throughout my visit. They made me feel comfortable and ensured I had a pleasant experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was calm, clean, and peaceful, making it the perfect place to unwind and de-stress.

The therapists were skilled, and I was very satisfied with the quality of the treatments. The spa was well-maintained, and the overall ambiance added to the relaxing experience.

Overall, I'm very happy with my visit and would definitely recommend Maya Spa to anyone looking for quality spa services and excellent customer care. I'll be happy to visit again!
reviewList.author: Archana Nair 1997

reviewList.text: Wow. Just randomly found this place, MAYA Spa, walking back from a different massage place that did not meet online expectations. They are the real deal. Had Anh as a therapist and got aroma massage 60min. Asked for firm pressure.and that was definitely what I got. No skimping on force for these tight muscles or on time. Included hand, head and foot massage as well as rub down to the rest of the body, some Thai-style stretching, etc. There was dry heat with beanbags of sorts before the stretching and a scrub down after the oil. You get tea and a cool towel before the foot bath and a delicious mango yogurt and watermelon after the hour of services -- all for 360K! 5 stars! I will be coming back and bringing the rest of my crew before we leave Da Nang 😊
reviewList.author: Kristen U

reviewList.text: Stumbled upon this place while passing by and later found it on Google with 2,000+ reviews, so I decided to give it a try. It was my first bamboo massage, and I was pleasantly surprised by the warm bamboo sticks and the eye mask provided during the treatment. The therapist was attentive, and the session was very relaxing. I also appreciated the thoughtful touches, from the welcome drink and refreshing wipes to the complimentary mango yogurt and fresh fruits after the massage. My only suggestion would be to add some soft background music in the massage room. Overall, a great experience and well worth a visit! 🌿✨
reviewList.author: Chai Elyn

reviewList.text: I had an excellent massage experience. The therapist was professional, friendly, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. The massage was relaxing while also targeting the areas that needed attention, and I left feeling refreshed and completely rejuvenated. The facilities were clean, peaceful, and welcoming, creating the perfect atmosphere to unwind. I highly recommend this place and will definitely return on my next visit.
reviewList.author: Gareth Griffiths

reviewList.text: My review is way overdue, but it’s never too late to express gratitude for a marvelous experience. During my Da Nang visit in January, my friend and I dropped in at Maya Spa for a one-hour massage. Stepping into the beautifully appointed and spotlessly clean space was like entering a slice of heaven, with soft music enveloping us as we began our session with refreshments (and ended with more tasty treats). I requested a gentle full-body massage and the masseuse soon had me feeling peaceful and soothed. My thanks to the professional staff—friendly and skilled in their practice—and the owner, who was warm and thoughtful. Kudos to the interior designer for creating serenity in this space with precious attention to details. I know. I’m raving. But there aren’t enough words to share how enjoyable it was to have found Maya Spa—among the special highlights of my stay in Da Nang.

The massage was one of the best I’ve had, perfectly balancing relaxation with just the right amount of pressure to work out the tension from my travels.

The facility was spotless, beautifully maintained, and had a peaceful, calming atmosphere that made it easy to completely unwind. I also appreciated the attention to detail and the genuine hospitality shown by everyone on the team.

If you’re visiting Da Nang and looking for a high-quality spa experience that offers excellent value without compromising on service, I can’t recommend this place highly enough. I’ll definitely be returning the next time I’m in the city.

reviewList.text: 🩵 My favourite set of nails I’ve ever had! Be Heo is incredibly talented and made sure every detail was perfect. The whole experience was so relaxing, and everyone in the salon was friendly, welcoming, and kind. I’m absolutely in love with my nails and would highly recommend this salon. Amazing service! ✨
reviewList.author: Molly McCann

reviewList.text:
They come up as a suggested salon for a reason. I have nothing but praises for all of the ladies at this salon. EVERY service (& we got a lot) was PERFECT. From the hand and foot massage to the perfect polish to the level of care and patience they exhibited with my daughters mani-pedi to the dream-inducing head spa, I am SO glad I chose to come to this salon.

I think what set these ladies apart is how patient they were with my hair. I’ve been to a few head spas in the past, and no one has really ever tried to really detangle my curly hair. I woke up to (because that head scrub and massage definitely put me to sleep) three sets of hands in my curls trying to gently separate and detangle my hair. I showed them how to work from the bottom and in sections with my hair type, and the ladies told me how happy they were to learn how to manage my hair texture.

All around, this was a great experience and I will definitely only come here every time I am in Da Nang.

My nail artist was very detailed and meticulous in filing my nails and shaping them beautifully, and applying multiple coats. One of the best manicures I have ever done and I love my new nails.

reviewList.text: I had an amazing experience at Thao Nails! reviewList.text:
This is probably the best place in the world I’ve ever been to. From the very first step, you feel an atmosphere of comfort, calm, and true Balinese relaxation. The interior is thoughtfully designed down to the smallest detail: lush greenery, soft lighting, and natural materials — everything makes you feel like you’re far away from the noise of the city.

I was especially impressed by the attention to detail: the way tea and fruits are served feels like a special ritual rather than just a snack. After the massage, you feel completely recharged — both physically and emotionally.

The staff is very attentive and friendly, and the service is truly top-notch. You can tell they genuinely care about your comfort.

If you want to truly relax and experience more than just a massage, this place is definitely worth visiting. I would come back here without hesitation.
reviewList.author: Юрий Ковалёв

reviewList.text:
Had a great spa experience here!

It was my last day in Danang was walking around to get some spa before heading to the airport and I did not expect to get this amazing experience.

The staff were so polite and helpful! The overall spa experience is heaven! Will definitely try this again on my next Danang Trip!
reviewList.author: Junard Roa

reviewList.text:
Very good place to spend relaxing time. I did the 20-step relaxing hair and body spa, and it was absolutely incredible from start to finish. Every step felt intentional, deeply relaxing, and luxurious.
The ambiance was perfect for unwinding, and the staff was professional and attentive. If you're looking to pamper yourself and completely de-stress, I highly recommend this place. I left feeling completely refreshed!

A special thank you to my nail technician, Trang—she is absolutely amazing! She was meticulous, gentle, and paid great attention to every detail. My nails turned out beautiful and exactly how I wanted them. Highly recommend Trang and the entire team. I’ll definitely come back on my next visit to Da Nang! 💅✨💕

reviewList.text: Kha Trang is genuinely the most talented artist. Everyone at the salon was amazing. But Kha Trang had amazing attention to detail my nails looked even better than the refrence photo. I couldn’t recommend this place more!! The best place i’ve ever been to :) She needs a raise

reviewList.text: My daughter really enjoyed her experience here. Very friendly staff and great work.

reviewList.text: They’re super fast and they did such a beautiful job!!!
reviewList.author: Minkyung Olivia Kim

reviewList.text: Amazing fast and friendly service! It was my friends first time getting their nails done and they absolutely loved it, they were able to do exactly what they were looking for. They also offered to hold our luggage for free as we had a few hours before our flight. On top of that also provide transportation to the airport for us!! I highly recommend going here if you're in the area.
reviewList.author: Tran Pham

reviewList.text:
I wouldn’t recommend this place if you’re concerned about sanitation, because they do not use new nail files for each customer. She also did not sanitize the nail cutter before cutting my nails, but she did spray what seemed like sanitizer on the cuticle cutters before use.

I got a single color gel manicure. She cut my nails on my left hand and my right hand at different lengths.. the right hand’s nails were longer. Additionally, the nail polish was painted unevenly (at a slight slant) at the cuticle on some nails.

The salon has the ability to do rly amazing nails (looking at the nails of the techs) but cutting the nails at different lengths and painting at a slant on a single color gel manicure does feel a little amateur. I didn’t hate it but would def try another location next time. Take what of this review as you will.
reviewList.author: K Lee

reviewList.text: This was my first time here and I will absolutely be back! I got a full gel x set and a pedicure for 1.2m not including tip. Both techs did an amazing job and really took their time, even though the service went past closing time. They kept checking in and even redid a couple of designs even though I thought they looked fine. I love that they give you 5 days to come back if you're not satisfied with your nails. I also appreciated that they told me the total before starting the service.
reviewList.author: Laurenne Ash

reviewList.text: It’s my first time here and I recommend this Nail Salon 10/10. It took her roughly 3 hours but this is definitely worth it. So pretty and perfect! Thank you Huong Trang Hanho for this perfect and beautiful nails! Will definitely come back again! 🫶🏼🥰 Staff are nice and accommodating.
reviewList.author: Ellysa Rotarla

reviewList.text:
I want to leave the warmest review for this wonderful place! I got a manicure and pedicure here by an amazing nail artist named Ha Nho — she seriously has hands of gold! The work was done perfectly, and the result was exactly what I wanted.
The staff is incredibly helpful and friendly. I couldn't decide on the color and shape of my nails for a really long time, but everyone was so patient with me. The girls genuinely cared and kept working until I was 100% happy with the result.
A huge bonus goes to their safety and hygiene standards! The clippers and tools weren't just pulled "out of a pocket" like it sometimes happens. Everything was carefully taken out of a special pouch and sanitized right in front of me.
Overall, this place is absolutely amazing! 🔥 I highly recommend this salon and the wonderful master Ha Nho!
reviewList.author: Vasilisa Anhel

reviewList.text: Got my pedicure and manicure done by Kha Ánh and couldn’t be happier! My nails looks exactly like the reference, and she made sure to be careful and pay attention to every detail of the design. I paid around $45 (₫1,200,000) for the service and felt like it was very appropriate for what I got. Would come here again!

reviewList.text: I made my nails 3 times here already. Can't be more satisfied 😊 Girls really know what they do. They work with different nail designs and listen to any preferences from the clients. Today I made my nails with the technician Anh75. Thank you again for your nice work 😊

reviewList.text:
We booked the 90-minute four-hands massage hoping for a relaxing and rejuvenating experience. We get massages regularly both in the US and while traveling, and have experienced four-hands treatments in many countries, so we have a solid basis for comparison.

While the massage may be acceptable by local standards, it did not feel like a true four-hands experience. The therapists were not synchronized at all. At one point, my left hand and fingers were being pulled while nothing was happening on the right side, which completely disrupted the flow a four-hands massage is meant to provide.

Communication was also very challenging. Without using a translation app, it was nearly impossible to communicate with the therapists. When I asked them to skip the bottoms of my feet, they didn’t understand. When I requested lighter pressure, they simply stopped working on that area altogether. During the session, my husband’s therapists chatted and giggled for much of the time, and my younger therapist occasionally joined in, while the older therapist remained mostly quiet. This was distracting and not relaxing—people go to spas to unwind, not to listen to staff conversations.

We had four therapists in total. The older therapist appeared to be guiding the other three, but one of the younger therapists pulled my left arm so forcefully that it caused pain, and I had to ask them to stop. The therapists also took bathroom breaks during the session. What made this uncomfortable was that they were using the bathroom inside the room, as we repeatedly heard toilet flushing, which felt unprofessional. One therapist slipped a couple of times while applying oil to my shoulder, indicating excessive oil use and poorly controlled movements. My left arm was still sore 48 hours later.

We didn't need pickup services and received the complimentary shampoo service while my husband had the foot scrub. I was led into a dimly lit room where three men were already having their hair washed, which was extremely uncomfortable. I later met them at check out and the guys also felt awkward when a stranger entered their space. I felt uneasy throughout the experience, unsure of what to expect. The stylist ended my session early, explaining that there were men in the room and took me back to the first floor to finish blow-drying my hair. For future guests, it would be helpful to clearly inform customers in advance that the shampoo area is a shared space so they can decide whether they are comfortable with that arrangement. My husband’s foot scrub, however, was fine. They also offer 15% discount off and I got a simply wax. Again, I used the translation app and it was ok.

Overall, the professionalism and coordination fell short of expectations. It wasn’t a terrible massage, but it was underwhelming and did not deliver the quality we anticipated. This service may be acceptable for guests new to four-hands massages, but for more experienced spa-goers, it may not meet expectations.

I had such a great experience at Lena Nails Beauty in Da Nang. I got a gel manicure and pedicure with Dung and Tam, and honestly, it was one of the best nail services I’ve ever had. They were both so detail-oriented, gentle, and professional — my nails turned out absolutely perfect.

I do want to share something I witnessed while I was there, because it really stayed with me. Another customer came in for a regular (non-gel) manicure and pedicure. Because of the humid, hot weather, her polish understandably took longer to dry. Unfortunately, she didn’t wait long enough before leaving, and her nails got smudged multiple times — first by accident, and later again when putting on flip-flops.

Tam kindly fixed the nails more than once, but the customer still became upset and blamed her. From what I saw, Tam handled the situation calmly and professionally the entire time. She even called her boss, and in the end, they refunded the customer, even though it really wasn’t the staff’s fault.

I just want to say that Tam did nothing wrong — she was patient, respectful, and did her job well under a stressful situation. Experiences like this say a lot about a business and its staff, and in this case, it only made me appreciate their professionalism even more.

I would absolutely come back and highly recommend Lena Nails Beauty to anyone visiting Da Nang.

reviewList.text:
I am incredibly particular about my nails, so when I say this salon impressed me, I mean it genuinely.

The level of attention to detail was evident. Without me having to ask, they applied two coats of base and three coats of colour as a matter of course, exactly the way it should be done, and exactly the kind of thing that separates a truly skilled nail technician from an average one. The design I brought as a reference was replicated with impressive accuracy, and the range of colours available made the whole selection process an absolute joy.

Shaping is usually where I am very particular of. I have almond-shaped nails and getting that right on the first try is not something many salons can do, but they did, effortlessly and without a single correction needed. For my pedicure, they used a fine brush to bring the polish right to the very edge of each nail, a technique reminiscent of a Russian manicure, and the finish was immaculate.

The salon itself is clean, well-spaced, and comfortable, with two dedicated technicians, one for manicure, one for pedicure, so everything flows efficiently without feeling rushed.

For context on value: nail design, gel removal, chrome, pedicure gel and removal came to 750,000 VND in total. Exceptional quality at an exceptional price.

Yes, they did ask me to leave a review, but I want to be clear that I would have written this regardless, because results like these deserve to be shared. I will absolutely be back the next time I’m in Da Nang.

reviewList.text:
On 23/6/2026, we were flying back to Singapore and had only about 2 hours before heading to the airport. We originally planned to visit another nail salon, but when we arrived, we found out it had already moved. We were completely caught off guard.

Luckily, we came across Shena Nail just a short walk away. My wife explained that we only had 45 minutes and asked if they could do both her manicure and pedicure. Without hesitation, they accepted.

The two Vietnamese manicurists worked so efficiently together and managed to finish everything within the time we had. Despite the rush, the quality of their work was excellent, and my wife was very happy with the result.

We are truly grateful to both of them. If we had been delayed by another 10 minutes, we would probably have missed our flight back to Singapore.

Thank you for your professionalism, efficiency, and kindness. You made the perfect ending to our Vietnam trip!

reviewList.author: Inggy

reviewList.text:
If you’re in Da Nang, Vietnam, do yourself a favor and book an appointment at EIRA Nails!

I had builder gel done on both my fingernails and toes, and y’all…I am beyond impressed. I’ve had my nails done all over the U.S., and I experienced techniques here that I’d never seen before. I found myself thinking, “Now where has THIS been all my life?”

What made this experience so special wasn’t just the beautiful results—it was the care. They paid attention to every tiny detail, never rushed, and treated me with such kindness from beginning to end. It felt less like a nail appointment and more like being pampered by people who genuinely take pride in their craft.

My nails are absolutely gorgeous, but honestly, the experience was just as beautiful. In a world where so many businesses are trying to get you in and out as quickly as possible, EIRA Nails reminded me what true customer care feels like.

Da Nang has won my heart, and EIRA Nails is one of the reasons why. If you want meticulous work, exceptional service, and a little reminder that slowing down is a good thing, this is your place.

Thank you for giving me the best nail salon experience I’ve ever had. I’ll definitely be back!

reviewList.text:
Unwelcome staff & Bad ettitude ,I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience was extremely disappointing. My friend and I booked online after seeing recommendations on Xiaohongshu. We bought the same package—mine for a manicure, hers for a pedicure. Her service skipped cuticle trimming completely, which was included. We tried to explain politely, even using Google Translate into Vietnamese, but one technician rolled her eyes, looked impatient, and spoke to a colleague while looking at us, which felt disrespectful. The salon also did not appear clean. The floor looked unclean, and overall, hygiene standards were concerning. I can’t confirm whether tools were properly sanitized, and that uncertainty made us very uneasy. Attitude, professionalism, and basic hygiene should be a given. I would strongly advise future customers to be very cautious before booking. Based on our experience, I cannot recommend this salon.

*After I received the owner replying review this msg u must read and understand before u listen from ur staff side.

I would like to clarify that my concern was never about heel exfoliation or callus removal.

The issue is that the pedicure package we booked included cuticle trimming/cuticle care, but this step was completely skipped. My friend only had the old gel removed and a new gel colour applied. No cuticle work was performed.

When we politely tried to clarify this using Google Translate due to the language barrier, one of your staff rolled her eyes, appeared impatient, and spoke to another staff member in Vietnamese while looking at us. Whether or not they were talking about us, their body language and attitude made us feel very uncomfortable and unwelcome.

In addition, the salon’s cleanliness was also a concern. The floor appeared dirty, and the overall hygiene did not give us confidence. While I cannot confirm whether the tools were properly sterilized, the environment did not make us feel reassured.

My review is based on my genuine experience. I appreciate your response, but it does not address the main concerns I raised regarding the missing cuticle care, staff attitude, and salon hygiene.

I hope this feedback will help improve your service for future customers.

English below
Tay nghề bé nhân viên ở đây đỉnh nha trời! Bén duyên với shop khoảng 1 năm trước trong buổi tối điên cuồng tìm tiệm nails cắt da, do tay mình ra dăm và da tay mỏng, nhiều chỗ cắt hay bị chảy máu. Mình tìm đại trên gg map mà va ngay tiệm chất lượng 10/10. Cắt da tay rất êm, ko cảm giác gì luôn, mà cắt sạch nét căng. Mình làm nail ở đây 2-3 lần rồi, dẫn bạn qua làm nữa. Từ dũa form, cầu móng, đi nét, nặn hoa hay lên màu, sơn móng đều nét căng đét!
Mình từng làm thử rất nhiều shop tay nghề cao nhưng thiếu tư duy thẩm mỹ thì móng nét nhưng tổng thể ko đẹp, nhưng tiệm này đỉnh nha~ Được cái shop chill lắm 🤣 Lễ cũng làm xuyên lễ~
Hợp với đứa có cái tính hứng lên là điên cuồng phải làm bộ nails cho bằng đc như mình
Thành shop guộc được gòi đó nha chời!

The nail techs here are seriously AMAZING, omg! 😂

I first discovered this shop about a year ago during one of those crazy nights when I was desperately looking for a nail salon that could do cuticle care properly. My cuticles tend to grow pretty rough and the skin around my nails is quite thin, so I often end up bleeding when other places cut them. I literally picked this place randomly on Google Maps — and somehow stumbled upon a solid 10/10 salon! 🥹✨

The cuticle care here is SO gentle. I literally don’t feel a thing, yet they get everything super clean and neat. I’ve gotten my nails done here 2–3 times now, and I’ve even brought my friends along.

From shaping, building the apex, creating clean lines, sculpting flowers, to color application and polishing — EVERYTHING is insanely precise! 🔥

I’ve tried quite a few salons with really skilled nail techs, but sometimes they have the technique without the aesthetic eye, so the nails may look technically perfect but the overall design just doesn’t look that good. But this place? THEY GET IT. 😭💅🏻

And another thing I love is how chill the shop is 🤣 They’re even open throughout the holidays~

Definitely perfect for someone like me, who randomly gets the urge to go absolutely crazy and HAS to get a whole new set of nails immediately. 😂

Okay, officially adding this place to my list of go-to nail salons now. 💅🏻✨

The spa itself is clean, nicely presented, and staff friendly and easy to communicate with. Initial drinks and snacks nice. Though our massage was I guess last one of the day, starting at 10pm. It may have been this factor that resulted in the whole process feeling rushed, from initial
Drinks, massage itself and after drink. Staff in and out of the room 3/4/5 times to get I believe towels and equipment. All should be brought in at start as sort of made the massage stop/start and less relaxing. The temperature a little hot and my side had LED lights which very bright and I’d suggest removing or turning them down as obviously lighting you want to be relaxing too. The massage itself was more jerky instead of smooth strokes and halfway through I thought perhaps the wrong clipboard with my pre circled choice had been mixed up and instead of an oil relaxing massage, I’d been given so one else’s Thai Massage. The masseuses was polite and attentive but I feel wasn’t quite hitting the right areas, and missed even massaging some parts. Clearly she was trying to do a good job but I felt perhaps lacked the skill and knowledge and maybe needs more practice. It felt like how I’d massage someone (I’m not a masseuse) which wouldn’t be that great. It did feel rushed and when finished I didn’t feel much different as before I walked in. I should have been leaving relaxed but wasn’t. Price and tip is clearly stated at beginning, and like I said the place clean, nice smelling and modern but the main reason you go is for a relaxing massage not the decor and lemongrass scent. Not the worst but not the best and I think if they can improves the staffs skill level and adjust lighting and not rush through pay/massage and hovering over you to finish your post drink, then I’d give another go

reviewList.text:
If there were a 0-star rating option, I would give it immediately… I had been to this salon once before and returned for a simple gel polish and nail extensions! The issue I'm talking about here isn't about whether it's good or bad, but the ATTITUDE OF THE STAFF AND THE OWNER! This is a newly opened nail salon in Thanh Khe… The first time I went, I got a plain gel polish on my natural nails, but after 7 days, the polish chipped and the tips were peeling off, even though I don't do much housework. At other places I've been to, even if the polish chipped, it would take at least two weeks to fix it! But at this salon, it chipped after only 7 days! I messaged the salon to ask them to improve their technique, and they offered a warranty and a 10% discount on my next visit… I don't have time to go through the trouble of getting two sets of nails done a week like that! I told them I'd reschedule for another time! The second time I went, I messaged the salon beforehand to book an appointment. They scheduled me for 6:15-6:30, and when I arrived at 6:00, someone was waiting for me. My sister had also had her hair washed there! It was great! But it wasn't like that for me... At 6:45, I still hadn't been served. I was fine with waiting and understanding, but when it came to filing the shape, even someone unfamiliar with the profession could see that it wasn't even. The middle finger was noticeably shorter than all the other nails, and it was particularly crooked!!! I told the staff member who was doing it to me, and she got annoyed and said, "I don't see anything short, ma'am, I see it's even." I pointed out that she needed to refile and redo it because a beautiful set of nails depends on the shape... She blamed my large, rough, and unattractive nails, saying, "What?!" If it were beautiful, I wouldn't have done it; it would have been beautiful as it was. I told the staff member, "Your hands clearly have a large, prominent crease, but even with your technicians, how can you make them look harmonious and beautiful for the client?" The staff member replied, "I'M NOT A DOCTOR, SIR!! HOW CAN I MAKE YOUR HANDS BEAUTIFUL?" Oh my god, how shameless! I've worked at many salons and have never received such an attitude, action, or words towards a customer! When the staff member called the owner, the owner couldn't resolve anything and acted exactly like the staff member! OMG! As the owner, I should at least have a polite and respectful attitude towards customers, but instead, they were sullen and rude!

I'm not picky; I don't care if the nail work is good or bad, or if the skills aren't perfect. But the service and attitude were TERRIBLE. If they had been cheerful, friendly, and apologized, I would have been happy to continue working on it, not to get so angry that I had to remove everything and leave! It was a huge waste of my time! I wasted two and a half hours only to have my hands look worse than before! It was such a waste of time and such a terrible experience! With this kind of business practice, customers will leave sooner or later! I messaged the owner, but they remained silent! It's outrageous! Everyone should consider avoiding this nail salon and not let it be like what happened to me!!

reviewList.text: My usual salon was closed for maternity leave, so I happened to get my hair washed at this one. It's a newly opened salon, quite empty, the staff are young, and the space is spacious, airy, and clean, so I've come back many times to support them and hope they'll have more customers in the future. There are two staff members; one is quite thorough with the shampoo and massage, while the other is a bit more perfunctory. The first time I got my nails done here, I found the method quite unusual, but the nails were durable and the staff were careful and meticulous, so I trusted them and got my box nails done. They were quite quick to do my nails and didn't ask any questions, which made me a little worried, but since it was my first time getting my nails done, I went along with it. However, my easygoing attitude backfired on their carelessness and lack of respect. When they attached the box nails to my first finger, they didn't pay attention, allowing air bubbles to get inside, making them visibly inflated (the gel nails are transparent, so you can see the air bubbles underneath). I immediately told them, "Please be careful because with air bubbles inside, the nails could easily fall off." But after all ten nails were done, 4 or 5 of them had the same air bubbles 🥲. You also measured the size incorrectly, making the nails smaller than my natural nails. If you had noticed the mistake, you should have redone those nails or let me know if you wanted them adjusted or if a slightly smaller size would have been acceptable. But you didn't do that. Even when I complained about it, I didn't receive any apology; you just stayed silent and simply didn't care. Normally, I get a set of nails done every 3-4 weeks, so a little imperfection is fine, but these are New Year's nails, how can you expect me to wear them like this at the beginning of the new year? (The salon wasn't busy at all, so you can't say it was because it was too busy that you did a sloppy job. Even if it were busy, an apology wouldn't take more than 10 seconds). Since it's close to Tet (Vietnamese New Year), the salon has slightly increased prices. I suggest you inform customers beforehand, for example, about a 10% surcharge during Tet or something similar, before they book or for regular customers. But the extra charge was negligible, so it was still acceptable. The staff were rather introverted; they didn't even greet customers, thank them, or say "I've received your transfer." They ignored customers as they left, sitting on their phones without even glancing at them or saying "come visit us next time," or "if you need your nails removed, come over and we'll help you," etc. Every time I finished a service, I felt like I had suddenly disappeared. Each regular customer is a potential gold mine; loyal customers who want to return are essential for long-term business. Normally, a customer gets 10-15 sets of nails done per year and hair washes 1-3 times a week. With that kind of behavior, how can you expect customers to come back? You should try working at other busy salons to see how their staff provide service. Since the salon is new, I hope you improve your service and attract more customers, retaining them.

reviewList.text:
First time getting cat eye nails, and I love them. I had no idea the process was so complex, and the tech who did my nail service did a great job. *** If you come to the salon, get the prices upfront and be extremely specific on what your charges are going to be. I don’t even pay as much as they attempted to charge me at first in the states for a quick polish change and “pedicure.” They had the nerve to try and charge me more than I would pay for a full body massage for a foot massage— that was supposed to be 45 minutes, but was only about 8 minutes.

I asked for a gel take off on my hands and feet, cat eye polish on my hands and regular gel on my toes. I added the “foot care” package for 250k, that was to include like 5 things— including a 45 minute foot massage. All I got was a “soak” and my heels… rubbed? and a approximately 8 minute (generous) foot massage.

Ultimately, this was a very unfortunate experience, as my actual service experience was an 8/10. I don’t want to give one star solely because of the issues at payment, but the more I think about the experience, the more upset I get about it. I was overcharged by almost 500,000 dong, and the response was, “It’s not that expensive to you, so you can just pay it.” lol what??? Then, “This isn’t a scam— you’re right, we need to be more clear with our pricing.” 1) I was SUPER chill about it and never even alluded to thinking they were scamming, and 2) no, the price menu is very clear— charging for never rendered services is THE issue.

I originally was going to give this place a 3 bc, up until the end, my experience was pleasant (I have VERY low expectations for pedicures here, so I wasn’t even moved by the lack of service there) and the couple there were super personable, but after reading similar recent experiences, 1 star it is.

Do better, guys. Foreigners do NOT like being taken advantage of, especially on a completely voluntary service.

reviewList.text:
Bumped into this place while i was looking for a money exchange shop and couldn't find any since my phone didn't have internet connection. I randomly asked one of the staff to point me to the nearest money exchange and even helped me get quick access to internet for proper google maps directions.

The following day, I went back to the store to avail one of their services as a way to thank them for the kindness they've shown the previous day. I've been walking on an average of 15k steps/day while exploring Da Nang and just realized maybe it's finally time to get a foot scrub and foot massage for the first time in my life (since i've also noticed that it is in almost every street near my hotel).

Surprisingly the foot scrub did not hurt at all. It kinda looked gross to see all the dry skins be flying all over the towel which made me feel bad for the staff doing it since it's my first time experiencing this haha. I even had to type in Google Translate how sorry i was. Out of embarrassment, i just gave a slightly higher tip to the staff. Even now that i left Da Nang my foot is still smooth and still feels unusual for a first timer.

I loved the friendliness of the staffs that i had to go back the following day and avail of their foot massage before i leave the country. This time the staff who accommodated me really took her time with the foot massage which i genuinely liked. The pressure was not that hard as much as i wanted it to be but it's decent to feel relaxed especially with the hot stone. (I also just didn't know how to properly communicate that i wanted stronger pressure haha).

Overall, it was nothing fancy or high-end, but it was definitely a great and memorable experience for me as a first timer and will definitely be back if I get a chance to visit Da Nang again in the future.

+ this spa also led me to discover one of my go to chicken shredded banh mi stores in Da Nang. It's just beside each other.
reviewList.author: Joshua

reviewList.text: I visited this salon today to try the famous Vietnamese-style nail art, and I am absolutely blown away! I got a Hello Kitty design, and the detail is incredible. The technician was extremely meticulous and professional, taking her time to make sure every line was perfect. If you're looking for high-quality, creative nails, this is the place to go. 5 stars!

reviewList.text: We purchased a 45-minute foot massage and foot scrub service. However, the actual service lasted only about 30 minutes. The masseuse rushed through the treatment and left to attend to other customers before our session time was completed. We did not receive the full service time that we paid for, which is unacceptable.

reviewList.text: We did a foot massage and foot scrub with machine to clear dead skin. Quite effective and no pain at all. Massage by small size girls with less strength but effective massage techniques.

reviewList.text: I visited the salon at about 19.20, to girls did the nails for me, it took a long time - 1 and a half hour for ombré, but it is worth it, and the price is good general. I recommend it for you as a tourist.
reviewList.author: Shalom Nguyen

reviewList.text:
The salon may not be as fancy or polished as some of the nail salons in tourist areas, but that was actually part of what I loved about it. It seemed to be a place that many locals visit, so it had the authentic local vibe I was looking for.

They can create pretty much any design you want, including trendy nail art, and they were incredibly detailed and careful with every step. I was really happy with the final result.

I also loved the music playing in the salon—it was totally my style! I found myself enjoying the Vietnamese songs so much that I realized how good Vietnamese music actually is. The music made the whole experience even more enjoyable. 🎶

If I visit Da Nang again, I’ll definitely come back here for my nails. Highly recommended!

reviewList.text:
Good price with best quality.

reviewList.text:
Local Nail Salon in Da Nang

This is my third visit, and every time I’m impressed by how professional and skillful they are. They always put so much care and effort into their work. The prices are also very reasonable, which makes it even better!

The foot callus removal treatment was amazing — it felt like I got a brand-new pair of feet! I had my service done on the first floor this time, and it was a bit too hot. Next time, please let me have it on the second floor with air conditioning 😥

I recommend booking through Instagram and picking your nail design in advance — it makes everything smoother.

I'll definitely come back whenever I visit Da Nang again. Please remember me next time! My name is Ms. Oh — I hope we can greet each other with a smile!
I will come  back in the winter.
See you~

reviewList.text: I got a few tooth gems and she covered them with glue so they didn’t even look good and then they came off less than two weeks later! She was nice so I feel bad, but this wasn’t a professional job.

reviewList.text: Loved this place so much! The ladies working here were the nicest and so fun and relaxed! Very professional work and able to do any design you desire. reviewList.text: Let me tell you how we were taken to the back alleys of Da Nang. We were looking for a foot massage place after a long day of tours and came across Hien. She was very sweet and super helpful. After explaining the services and prices to us, we followed her through a little sketch back alley to Jeju Spa. The moment we walked in and through our services, the ladies were hospitable and amazing. We all got foot massages and some got manis/pedis. The foot massages were catered to our needs, the ambiance was relaxing, and the foot soak was refreshing. I received a mani and pedi from Binh and she was so fun and cute. She was meticulous and did an awesome job. Totally recommend!

reviewList.text: I stumbled upon this fairly new spa close to Han River after  watching the final night of the fireworks competition a few days ago. I wanted to get foot exfoliation done as my feet were heavily calloused from months of traveling. The lady who was assigned to me ( I think her name is Mina) was incredibly sweet and kind. reviewList.text: A reservation is a must! Don’t let the small alleyway entrance fool you; once you step inside, the shop is spacious, clean, and has a great vibe. reviewList.text: The girls were able to fit me in last minute and did such a wonderful job! They’re so much cheaper compared to other salons in the area but don’t compromise on the quality at all. The service was so fast and efficient and they’re so sweet and friendly!

reviewList.text: Service is professional and efficient. They are very skilled, meticulous and willing to go the extra mile for customers. Will definitely go back again on my next trip to Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Jacqueline Kuak

reviewList.text:
This is a lovely nail salon with great service but could use more knowledge and expertise. For example, I came in with old regular nail polish that only needed to be removed with acetone, but they instead treated it as gel and used an electric nail file. I also requested nail extensions on two nails and they mentioned they would use an acrylic extension method but instead used press ons and nail glue (not gel x) which is a method that will not last as long.

However, the girls provide a lovely service and are very detailed and meticulous (maybe too much!). They mentioned that my appointment for a single colour gel manicure would take 30 minutes, but it instead took 2 hours. They put a lot of effort into cuticle care, filling and applying the nail polish. They also provided two layers of reinforcement gel for no extra price as well as cuticle oil and a short hand lotion massage. The whole service cost me 190,000 vnd which is a very good price.

I would recommend this nail salons for the price and quality of service but if you are looking for a short and efficient nail service, this may not be the place for you.
reviewList.author: Leticia Shiu

reviewList.text:
The staff here are lovely, enthusiastic, cheerful, and very relaxed. I've been getting my nails done here for a few months, since before Tet (Lunar New Year), and I'm very satisfied. The quality and durability are consistent, so I was planning to leave a review to share my real experience, but it seems like the salon is being targeted with fake 1-star reviews.

It seems like they mainly accept appointments, because they're very punctual. I booked in advance via hotline, so I never had to wait, even during Tet. The prices are also incredibly cheap. I keep seeing regular customers recommending each other; I've met acquaintances and classmates several times. This salon seems very low-key; they don't run ads, so they don't have many walk-in customers. They even seem unaware of customer reviews that went viral on Twitter and other platforms. 😂
A message to my dear shop: please don't be upset by those fake reviews, I can tell they're spam just by reading them. You ladies are so amazing and lovely! I wish your shop eternal success so I can have my favorite nail salon forever. Love you all ♥️🔥
reviewList.author: Nhung

reviewList.text:
Refrain from going to this spa

I had a very disappointing experience at Casa Leafy Spa in Awaken Hotel Danang. Unfortunately, the service quality fell far below expectations.

The therapists demonstrated a clear lack of professionalism and service knowledge. Communication was extremely poor, and throughout the session they were talking and laughing among themselves, which made it difficult to relax. At times, they even left the treatment room door wide open when stepping out, which felt inappropriate and uncomfortable.
Basic details were also overlooked. The towels provided were cold rather than warm, and overall the setup did not feel hygienic or carefully managed. My husband even became unwell after using the face pillow, which was not covered with a towel—something that should be a standard hygiene practice.

Additionally, the Vietnamese massage did not match what was advertised. The spa menu stated that balm would be used, but this was not the case during the treatment. We were also surprised to find that access to the steam and sauna rooms came at an extra cost, despite being presented as part of the hotel amenities.

When I raised these concerns with the manager, there was no meaningful acknowledgment or offer to resolve the situation, which was particularly disappointing.

Overall, this was an entirely negative experience, and I would not recommend this spa.
reviewList.author: Sabeena Lal

reviewList.text: Excellent massages.. fair prices for service well done. nice clean facilities and also safe and trustworthy. Drinks and cookies and candy included. Ladies did a fantastic job!
reviewList.author: Mano Phichith

reviewList.text:
Casa Leafy Spa & Beauty was a disappointing experience overall, especially considering the price point.

I actually gave it two chances, booking treatments on separate occasions as I thought perhaps I hadn’t experienced their service properly the first time. Unfortunately, the experience was inconsistent. During the first visit, there wasn’t even a face towel placed over the face cradle, which felt like a basic oversight.

On the second visit, this was done correctly but that kind of inconsistency shouldn’t happen.

During the 60-minute massage, the therapists talked to each other throughout, which made it difficult to relax and defeated the purpose of the treatment. It felt unprofessional and quite distracting.

We had also booked an Indian oil head massage, but ended up cancelling it after staff spent around 10 minutes trying to get things set up. It was unclear why this wasn’t prepared in advance, and even more confusing that other staff members—who didn’t appear to be busy—didn’t step in to help make the experience smoother.

Another odd point: the spa facilities themselves aren’t available for use. We were told it’s “too noisy” and affects nearby treatments, which raises the question of why those facilities are there in the first place.

Even with a 20% promotional discount, the experience didn’t justify the cost.

Unfortunately, it fell short on both service and overall value.
reviewList.author: David Brown

reviewList.text: Got the Head to Toe 120 minute spa package. Truely was not expecting the amount of services we got in it. The massage itself was very good and the head massage and hair wash was good (I have quite frizzy hair so wasn’t expecting much but they did a decent job not making my hair frizz, my partner noted that they washed his beard but didn’t include it in the drying). Only other thing would be communication methods, we were told to leave phones in locker (obviously for relaxation) but found it a little difficult communicating both ways but not a big issue just involved a lot of hand guestures :)

reviewList.text: This was by far the worst experience I’ve ever had. Save your time and money—this service is absolutely not worth it. I’m one of the easiest-going people you’ll ever meet, and I’ve never walked out of a session before—but this time, I was just too disappointed to stay.

reviewList.text:
I had a lovely experience here!! I was just interested in getting my toes done, but after seeing their great prices, I opted for an herbal footbath/massage combo, shampoo/shoulder massage combo, and gel pedicure.
The girl doing my pedicure was great--I showed her a picture of what I wanted, and she was so invested in trying to copy it exactly, and kept checking for my approval. It came out even better than I imagined! The leg massage was very thorough as well.
My 2nd favorite was definitely the shampoo and massage...almost fell asleep, it was so lovely. She blow-dryed my hair after, so it looks better than it has in a week, since I got here. 😂 And they were busy, but got to everyone quickly! Can't recommend enough. ^^

reviewList.text: It was my first time getting my nails done, and I was so impressed by how beautifully you designed such a detailed style. I’m sure this will make my trip even more special. Thank you so much!

reviewList.text: The pedicure was great, and the foot massage was fantastic. Truly one of the best foot massages I’ve head in my travels through SE Asia. The staff is very friendly and professional. I will be back soon.
reviewList.author: Nichol Simpson

reviewList.text:
I went to ZozoNails during my vacation here today because of all the great reviews on Google but I am unlucky enough to have a terrible experience there.

I chose to do a Gel Manicure and a normal Pedicure, they are both very reasonably priced.

Pedicure was where my nightmare begins , it was honestly the most painful experience I have had at a nail salon, at first Staff A (a gentleman) was doing my cuticle cutting and he managed to cut through my cuticle and left it bleeding. (Both my big toe and my middle toe). I was shocked and he only used water and cotton to clean it until I expressed my worries, and asked 'Is it okay?' No apologies received, but thank god he went to get some disinfectant to put it on my cuticle - which you can imagine, it was PAINFUL. (You can see attached photo)

After that, it was already very uncomfortable obviously but the worst was when the inexperienced Staff B (another gentleman) was putting the nail polish on, and made mistakes for like 3-4 times.... my cuticle were stinging so badly when he used the nail polish remover to clear the uneven polish before he can re-do it again. It was a torture...

Okay, onto the Manicure, Staff B was responsible for filing the previous gel away and that was very rough, a few times I actually withdrawn my hand reactively because I felt like he was gonna file my cuticle off. After he went on to do my pedicure as I mentioned above, Staff C (a lady) was responsible to do my manicure instead, I requested not to get my cuticle cut so I thought it will be fine. AND I WAS WRONG, she managed to clip the skin next to my nail until the flesh of the underside of the nail is exposed (as you can see on the attached photo), it wasn't bleeding but it hurt a lot and it's all red and exposed....

The manager apologised after I expressed how frustrated I was and waived me the cost of the pedicure. In the end It was a very cheap deal but it was an awful and painful experience that I wish I have never come across.

Sadly this is my honest review, I cannot even say I have been allocated to 1 inexperienced staff, because I have had 3 and they were not professional IMHO.

Uneven filed nails, bubbles underneath the gel nails (which are also my case) - Fine, it's a very affordable place, I don't expect 5 stars quality, but bleeding in a nail salon? No thank you, that is just a basic expectation. Not mentioning now I might have the risk of getting an infection in the coming few days.....

I hope this review is helpful and I would like you to think twice before you go.
reviewList.author: Roni Cheung
